img_106.description: Central circle ringed by a line of script. Inside: a pale, outline-drawn four-legged animal with a long neck, a curled horn swept back over the head and a short tail, reaching to nibble a green plant on the left. It stands on a green, scalloped ground line. Around the ring, clothed women stand in striped tubs/barrels holding stars.
img_106.central_figure: A goat- or ram-like animal with a curled horn, eating from a green plant
img_106.sign_reason: Horned, goat/ram-shaped body with backward-curling horn and no fish tail; slender build unlike a bull. Could also be read as Capricorn, but there is no fish tail.

img_649.description: Faint ink drawing in a central circle with script around it. A four-legged animal with a round head, small ears, an open mouth, big clawed paws raised, faint blue speckling on the body, a red dot on the hindquarters, and a long tail curving under. A wheat-like plant sprig is at upper right. Outer zone shows outlined nude figures.
img_649.central_figure: A lion-like big cat with clawed paws and a long tail
img_649.sign_reason: Feline head, clawed paws and long tail of a lion; nothing horned or hoofed.

img_602.description: Central circle with script ring. A seated figure in a long blue-streaked robe with a fan of pleated cloth to the right, wearing a blue cap; one hand extended toward an eight-pointed star; a small flower on the ground at bottom left. Outlined nude figures fill the outer zone.
img_602.central_figure: A single robed figure seated, holding up or pointing to a star, with a small flower nearby
img_602.sign_reason: A single human figure in a long gown with a flower/plant, no weapon, no scales, no partner: fits the maiden. Gender is ambiguous (cap), so not certain.

img_320.description: Small central circle with script ring. Two crustaceans stacked: the upper one pale green with red claws, the lower one painted red, each with many legs and pincers. Many nude female figures with stars radiate around the circle.
img_320.central_figure: Two crayfish or lobsters, one green and one red
img_320.sign_reason: Clawed, many-legged crustaceans (crab/crayfish) are the standard Cancer emblem.

img_505.description: Central circle with script ring and a large eight-pointed star above. A small grey-green four-legged animal with a pointed snout or tongue, short legs and a long tail that curls up into a loop over its back. Outer zone has outlined nude figures and stars.
img_505.central_figure: A small green lizard- or salamander-like animal with an upturned looped tail
img_505.sign_reason: Not a lion, goat, bull or human; the long tail curled up over the back is the scorpion-like trait, and the green reptilian body suggests a lizard/dragon standing in for a scorpion. Uncertain because it is not a recognisable scorpion.

img_253.description: Central circle with script ring. A man in a green tunic and green cap and a woman in a long blue gown with long hair stand facing each other, holding hands/clasping something between them. Nude female figures with stars surround the circle.
img_253.central_figure: A man and a woman, clothed, holding hands
img_253.sign_reason: A pair of human figures together is the Gemini (twins/lovers) emblem.

img_853.description: Central circle inside a band of figures in woven tubs holding stars. Inside: an olive-green goat-like animal with two curving horns, bearded/pointed muzzle, slender legs and a short tail, nibbling a dark green bush on a stem; it stands on a scalloped ground line with a blue wash.
img_853.central_figure: A green-brown horned goat or ram eating from a bush
img_853.sign_reason: Slim goat/ram body with curved horns, no fish tail; same design as img_106. Capricorn is the alternative but lacks the fish tail.

img_421.description: Central circle with script ring. A red-painted four-legged animal with two tall upright horns, heavy body, hooves and a long tail, eating green leaves out of a woven basket on the left; green ground line. Nude women in tubs holding stars surround it; a hole in the vellum at left.
img_421.central_figure: A red horned animal (bull-like) feeding from a basket
img_421.sign_reason: Heavier body with upright horns and long tufted tail looks more bovine than goat; red bull is a common Taurus depiction. Could be a goat (Aries/Capricorn).

img_579.description: Central circle with script ring. A pinkish-red horned four-legged animal with upright horns and a long tail eating dark green leaves from a woven basket; green ground line. Clothed figures in tubs/towers around the ring.
img_579.central_figure: A pink/red horned animal (bull-like) eating from a basket
img_579.sign_reason: Same design as img_421: upright horns, heavier body, long tail, basket feed; reads as a bull. Goat-like alternatives possible.

img_514.description: Central circle with script ring. A standing person in a wide-brimmed hat and blue tunic/skirt holds a crossbow pointed down to the left. Outlined nude figures and stars around.
img_514.sign_reason: An archer (here with a crossbow) is the Sagittarius emblem.

img_558.description: Central circle with script ring. A balance: a central post with a beam and two hanging pans/buckets with blue inside. Outlined nude figures fill the outer ring.
img_558.sign_reason: A balance with two pans is the Libra emblem.

img_229.description: Large central circle with several script rings and an outer band of hatched tub/figure shapes with green. Two scaly fish facing opposite directions, joined by a long curving cord/line, with a blue wavy water line below and two six-pointed stars, one labelled.
img_229.central_figure: Two fish joined by a cord
img_229.sign_reason: Two fish tied together by a line is the classic Pisces emblem.

recognise_source: Yes: these are the zodiac roundels of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), the circular zodiac pages with nude/clothed figures in tubs holding stars and Voynich-script labels.
